def main():
    print("\n" + "=" * 78)
    print("PAD-Stream V16B-1")
    print("Fast Marching Governing Metric / Speed-Field Contract Audit")
    print("=" * 78)

    print("""
FOUNDATION CASE 0001 IS IMMUTABLE.
NO FAST MARCHING SOLVE WILL BE EXECUTED.
NO ARRIVAL-TIME FIELD WILL BE GENERATED.
NO SG3 PRESSURE SOLVE WILL BE RERUN.
NO SG4 DARCY FLUX WILL BE RERUN.
NO VELOCITY FIELD WILL BE RECOMPUTED FROM PHYSICS.
NO POLLOCK STREAMLINE WILL BE RETRACED.
NO MODEL.PREDICT CALL WILL BE EXECUTED.
NO TRAINING WILL BE PERFORMED.
ONLY THE V16B FMM GOVERNING SPEED / METRIC CONTRACT WILL BE DEFINED.
""")

    manifest, arrays = load_foundation()

    if manifest.get("status") != "V16A_FOUNDATION_CASE_0001_FROZEN_COMPLETE":
        raise RuntimeError("V16B-1 requires frozen Foundation Case 0001.")

    required = [
        "Kx",
        "Ky",
        "Kz",
        "porosity",
        "pressure",
        "Qx",
        "Qy",
        "Qz",
        "Vx",
        "Vy",
        "Vz",
        "streamline_xyz",
        "pollock_tof",
        "streamline_weight",
    ]

    missing = [name for name in required if name not in arrays]

    if missing:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Foundation Case 0001 is missing required V16B-1 inputs: "
            + ", ".join(missing)
        )

    foundation_hash = sha256_file(FOUNDATION_NPZ)

    save_csv(
        IDENTITY_CSV,
        [
            {
                "foundation_file": str(FOUNDATION_NPZ),
                "foundation_sha256": foundation_hash,
                "manifest_file": str(FOUNDATION_MANIFEST),
                "manifest_sha256": sha256_file(FOUNDATION_MANIFEST),
                "foundation_status": manifest.get("status"),
            }
        ],
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Candidate metric audit
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    candidates = [
        {
            "candidate": "M0",
            "name": "CONSTANT_GEOMETRIC_SPEED",
            "pressure_dependent": False,
            "permeability_dependent": False,
            "flow_dependent": False,
            "porosity_dependent": False,
            "selected_primary": False,
            "role": "GEOMETRIC_CONTROL_ONLY",
            "reason": "No reservoir-flow physics.",
        },
        {
            "candidate": "M1",
            "name": "FROZEN_DARCY_PORE_SPEED_MAGNITUDE",
            "pressure_dependent": True,
            "permeability_dependent": True,
            "flow_dependent": True,
            "porosity_dependent": True,
            "selected_primary": True,
            "role": "PRIMARY_FMM_PHYSICS_BASELINE",
            "reason": "Directly inherits frozen SG3-SG5 permeability-pressure-Darcy-flow physics.",
        },
        {
            "candidate": "M2",
            "name": "PRESSURE_GRADIENT_MOBILITY_PROXY",
            "pressure_dependent": True,
            "permeability_dependent": True,
            "flow_dependent": True,
            "porosity_dependent": True,
            "selected_primary": False,
            "role": "DERIVED_REFERENCE_ONLY",
            "reason": "Would rederive flow from K and grad(p), duplicating frozen V field.",
        },
        {
            "candidate": "M3",
            "name": "PERMEABILITY_ONLY_PROXY",
            "pressure_dependent": False,
            "permeability_dependent": True,
            "flow_dependent": False,
            "porosity_dependent": True,
            "selected_primary": False,
            "role": "GEOLOGICAL_SENSITIVITY_REFERENCE",
            "reason": "Does not include pressure forcing and is not an advective travel-time analogue.",
        },
    ]

    save_csv(CANDIDATE_CSV, candidates)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Exact face-to-cell velocity transformation
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Vx = np.asarray(arrays["Vx"], dtype=np.float64)
    Vy = np.asarray(arrays["Vy"], dtype=np.float64)
    Vz = np.asarray(arrays["Vz"], dtype=np.float64)

    Vxc = face_to_cell_x(Vx)
    Vyc = face_to_cell_y(Vy)
    Vzc = face_to_cell_z(Vz)

    expected_cell_shape = (15, 50, 50)

    if Vxc.shape != expected_cell_shape:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Unexpected Vxc shape: {Vxc.shape}")

    if Vyc.shape != expected_cell_shape:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Unexpected Vyc shape: {Vyc.shape}")

    if Vzc.shape != expected_cell_shape:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Unexpected Vzc shape: {Vzc.shape}")

    speed_raw = np.sqrt(Vxc**2 + Vyc**2 + Vzc**2)

    if not np.all(np.isfinite(speed_raw)):
        raise RuntimeError("Raw FMM speed contains non-finite values.")

    eps, median_positive = positive_floor(speed_raw)

    speed_fmm = np.maximum(speed_raw, eps)

    floor_mask = speed_raw < eps

    save_csv(
        CENTERING_CSV,
        [
            {
                "component": "Vx -> Vxc",
                "face_shape": str(tuple(Vx.shape)),
                "cell_shape": str(tuple(Vxc.shape)),
                "boundary_rule": "adjacent-face value",
                "interior_rule": "arithmetic mean of bracketing faces",
            },
            {
                "component": "Vy -> Vyc",
                "face_shape": str(tuple(Vy.shape)),
                "cell_shape": str(tuple(Vyc.shape)),
                "boundary_rule": "adjacent-face value",
                "interior_rule": "arithmetic mean of bracketing faces",
            },
            {
                "component": "Vz -> Vzc",
                "face_shape": str(tuple(Vz.shape)),
                "cell_shape": str(tuple(Vzc.shape)),
                "boundary_rule": "adjacent-face value",
                "interior_rule": "arithmetic mean of bracketing faces",
            },
        ],
    )

    save_csv(
        SPEED_STATS_CSV,
        [
            {
                "field": "speed_raw_m_s",
                "shape": str(tuple(speed_raw.shape)),
                "min": float(np.min(speed_raw)),
                "p01": float(np.percentile(speed_raw, 1)),
                "p05": float(np.percentile(speed_raw, 5)),
                "median": float(np.median(speed_raw)),
                "mean": float(np.mean(speed_raw)),
                "p95": float(np.percentile(speed_raw, 95)),
                "p99": float(np.percentile(speed_raw, 99)),
                "max": float(np.max(speed_raw)),
                "zero_count": int(np.sum(speed_raw == 0.0)),
                "positive_count": int(np.sum(speed_raw > 0.0)),
                "sha256": sha256_array(speed_raw),
            },
            {
                "field": "speed_fmm_m_s",
                "shape": str(tuple(speed_fmm.shape)),
                "min": float(np.min(speed_fmm)),
                "p01": float(np.percentile(speed_fmm, 1)),
                "p05": float(np.percentile(speed_fmm, 5)),
                "median": float(np.median(speed_fmm)),
                "mean": float(np.mean(speed_fmm)),
                "p95": float(np.percentile(speed_fmm, 95)),
                "p99": float(np.percentile(speed_fmm, 99)),
                "max": float(np.max(speed_fmm)),
                "zero_count": int(np.sum(speed_fmm == 0.0)),
                "positive_count": int(np.sum(speed_fmm > 0.0)),
                "sha256": sha256_array(speed_fmm),
            },
        ],
    )

    save_csv(
        REG_CSV,
        [
            {
                "regularization": "positive_speed_floor",
                "formula": "epsilon = max(float64_tiny, 1e-6 * median_positive_speed)",
                "median_positive_speed_m_s": median_positive,
                "epsilon_m_s": eps,
                "cells_floored": int(np.sum(floor_mask)),
                "fraction_floored": float(np.mean(floor_mask)),
                "foundation_arrays_modified": False,
                "scope": "V16B_FMM_METRIC_ONLY",
            }
        ],
    )

    # Persist the V16B metric artifact.
    np.savez_compressed(
        SPEED_NPZ,
        Vxc_m_s=Vxc,
        Vyc_m_s=Vyc,
        Vzc_m_s=Vzc,
        speed_raw_m_s=speed_raw,
        speed_fmm_m_s=speed_fmm,
        speed_floor_mask=floor_mask.astype(np.uint8),
        epsilon_m_s=np.asarray([eps], dtype=np.float64),
        authority_label_ascii=np.frombuffer(
            b"PAD_STREAM_V16B1_FMM_SPEED_CONTRACT",
            dtype=np.uint8,
        ),
    )

    gates = [
        ("foundation_case_0001_status_reproduced", True),
        ("foundation_sha256_recorded", True),
        ("all_required_foundation_inputs_present", len(missing) == 0),
        ("FMM_candidate_metric_matrix_constructed", True),
        ("M1_selected_as_primary_physics_baseline", True),
        ("Vx_face_to_cell_contract_valid", Vxc.shape == expected_cell_shape),
        ("Vy_face_to_cell_contract_valid", Vyc.shape == expected_cell_shape),
        ("Vz_face_to_cell_contract_valid", Vzc.shape == expected_cell_shape),
        ("raw_speed_finite", np.all(np.isfinite(speed_raw))),
        ("raw_speed_nonnegative", np.min(speed_raw) >= 0.0),
        ("positive_speed_population_exists", np.any(speed_raw > 0.0)),
        ("speed_floor_deterministically_defined", eps > 0.0),
        ("FMM_speed_strictly_positive", np.min(speed_fmm) > 0.0),
        ("no_double_porosity_division", True),
        ("foundation_arrays_not_modified", True),
        ("no_FMM_solve_executed", True),
        ("no_arrival_time_generated", True),
        ("no_SG3_rerun", True),
        ("no_SG4_rerun", True),
        ("no_velocity_physics_recompute", True),
        ("no_Pollock_retrace", True),
        ("no_model_predict", True),
        ("no_training", True),
    ]

    save_csv(
        GATES_CSV,
        [{"gate": name, "passed": bool(value)} for name, value in gates],
    )

    all_pass = all(bool(value) for _, value in gates)

    if all_pass:
        status = "V16B_FMM_GOVERNING_SPEED_CONTRACT_READY"
        diagnosis = (
            "FROZEN_DARCY_PORE_SPEED_MAGNITUDE_PROVIDES_ONE_POSITIVE_SOURCE_AUTHENTIC_ISOTROPIC_FMM_PROPAGATION_FIELD"
        )
        recommendation = (
            "Freeze the V16B-1 speed contract. Proceed to V16B-2 and implement the exact 3D Eikonal/Fast-Marching solver "
            "using speed_fmm_m_s, with the injector completion interval as the zero-arrival source set. "
            "Do not tune the speed field against Pollock TOF."
        )
        next_milestone = "V16B-2 — Exact 3D Fast Marching Arrival-Time Baseline"
    else:
        status = "V16B_FMM_GOVERNING_SPEED_CONTRACT_BLOCKED"
        diagnosis = "ONE_OR_MORE_REQUIRED_FMM_SPEED_CONTRACT_GATES_FAILED"
        recommendation = (
            "Do not run Fast Marching. Audit only failed V16B-1 speed-field contract gates."
        )
        next_milestone = "V16B-1R — FMM Speed Contract Residual Audit"

    save_csv(
        DECISION_CSV,
        [
            {
                "status": status,
                "diagnosis": diagnosis,
                "selected_metric": "M1_FROZEN_DARCY_PORE_SPEED_MAGNITUDE",
                "speed_field": "speed_fmm_m_s",
                "speed_field_sha256": sha256_array(speed_fmm),
                "epsilon_m_s": eps,
                "foundation_sha256": foundation_hash,
                "next_milestone": next_milestone,
            }
        ],
    )

    contract = {
        "milestone": "V16B-1",
        "status": status,
        "diagnosis": diagnosis,
        "foundation": {
            "file": str(FOUNDATION_NPZ),
            "sha256": foundation_hash,
            "immutable": True,
        },
        "governing_equation": "|grad(T)| = 1/F",
        "selected_metric": {
            "id": "M1",
            "name": "FROZEN_DARCY_PORE_SPEED_MAGNITUDE",
            "definition": "F = max(sqrt(Vxc^2 + Vyc^2 + Vzc^2), epsilon)",
            "units": "m/s",
            "porosity_division_applied_in_V16B1": False,
            "reason": (
                "Frozen SG5 velocities already embody the Darcy-to-pore-velocity conversion used by Pollock; "
                "dividing by porosity again would double-count porosity."
            ),
        },
        "face_to_cell_contract": {
            "x": "boundary=adjacent face; interior=mean of bracketing x faces",
            "y": "boundary=adjacent face; interior=mean of bracketing y faces",
            "z": "boundary=adjacent face; interior=mean of bracketing z faces",
        },
        "regularization": {
            "formula": "epsilon = max(float64_tiny, 1e-6 * median_positive_speed)",
            "epsilon_m_s": eps,
            "cells_floored": int(np.sum(floor_mask)),
            "fraction_floored": float(np.mean(floor_mask)),
            "scope": "V16B FMM metric only",
        },
        "metric_artifact": {
            "file": str(SPEED_NPZ),
            "sha256": sha256_file(SPEED_NPZ),
            "speed_field_sha256": sha256_array(speed_fmm),
        },
        "comparison_policy": {
            "Pollock_TOF_used_for_metric_tuning": False,
            "Pollock_TOF_role": "independent frozen reference for downstream comparison only",
        },
        "constraints": {
            "FMM_executed": False,
            "arrival_time_generated": False,
            "foundation_mutated": False,
            "SG3_rerun": False,
            "SG4_rerun": False,
            "Pollock_retrace": False,
            "model_predict": False,
            "training": False,
        },
        "recommendation": recommendation,
        "next_milestone": next_milestone,
    }

    save_json(CONTRACT_JSON, contract)

    save_json(
        SUMMARY_JSON,
        {
            "milestone": "V16B-1",
            "status": status,
            "diagnosis": diagnosis,
            "selected_metric": contract["selected_metric"],
            "metric_artifact": contract["metric_artifact"],
            "recommendation": recommendation,
            "next_milestone": next_milestone,
        },
    )

    print("FOUNDATION")
    print(f"  File                    : {FOUNDATION_NPZ}")
    print(f"  SHA-256                 : {foundation_hash}")

    print("\nSELECTED FMM METRIC")
    print("  Candidate               : M1")
    print("  Name                    : FROZEN_DARCY_PORE_SPEED_MAGNITUDE")
    print("  Governing equation      : |grad(T)| = 1 / F")
    print("  Speed units             : m/s")
    print("  Divide by porosity again: False")

    print("\nCELL-CENTERED SPEED")
    print(f"  Shape                   : {speed_raw.shape}")
    print(f"  Raw min/max             : {np.min(speed_raw):.6e} / {np.max(speed_raw):.6e} m/s")
    print(f"  Median positive         : {median_positive:.6e} m/s")
    print(f"  FMM epsilon             : {eps:.6e} m/s")
    print(f"  Cells floored           : {np.sum(floor_mask)}")
    print(f"  Fraction floored        : {np.mean(floor_mask):.6e}")
    print(f"  FMM min/max             : {np.min(speed_fmm):.6e} / {np.max(speed_fmm):.6e} m/s")

    print("\n" + "=" * 78)
    print("V16B-1 FINAL GOVERNING METRIC GATES")
    print("=" * 78)

    for name, value in gates:
        print(f"[{'PASS' if value else 'FAIL'}] {name}")

    print("=" * 78)

    print("\nSTATUS")
    print(f"  {status}")

    print("\nDIAGNOSIS")
    print(f"  {diagnosis}")

    print("\nRECOMMENDATION")
    print(f"  {recommendation}")

    print("\nNEXT MILESTONE")
    print(f"  {next_milestone}")

    print("\nOUTPUTS")
    print(f"  Directory:\n    {OUT}")

    print("\nNumerical:")
    print(f"  {SPEED_NPZ.name}")
    print(f"  SHA-256: {sha256_file(SPEED_NPZ)}")

    print("\nTables:")
    for p in [
        IDENTITY_CSV,
        CANDIDATE_CSV,
        CENTERING_CSV,
        SPEED_STATS_CSV,
        REG_CSV,
        GATES_CSV,
        DECISION_CSV,
    ]:
        print(f"  {p.name}")

    print("\nContract:")
    print(f"  {CONTRACT_JSON.name}")

    print("\nSummary:")
    print(f"  {SUMMARY_JSON.name}")

    print("\n" + "=" * 78)
    print("PAD-STREAM V16B-1 FMM GOVERNING METRIC CONTRACT: COMPLETE")
    print("=" * 78)

def main():
    print("\n" + "=" * 78)
    print("PAD-Stream V16B-4")
    print("FMM / Pollock Discrepancy Structure & Directionality Audit")
    print("=" * 78)

    print("""
NO FMM SPEED FIELD WILL BE CHANGED.
NO FAST MARCHING SOLVE WILL BE RERUN.
NO POLLOCK STREAMLINE WILL BE RETRACED.
NO PRODUCER ID WILL BE INVENTED.
NO DIRECTIONAL CORRECTION WILL BE FIT.
NO SG3 / SG4 PHYSICS WILL BE RERUN.
NO MODEL.PREDICT CALL WILL BE EXECUTED.
NO TRAINING WILL BE PERFORMED.
THIS MILESTONE DIAGNOSES THE EXISTING V16B-3 DISCREPANCY ONLY.
""")

    for p in [
        FOUNDATION_NPZ, B1_SPEED, B2_ARRIVAL,
        B3_COMPARISON, B3_CONTRACT, B3_SUMMARY
    ]:
        if not p.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(p)

    b3_summary = load_json(B3_SUMMARY)
    b3_contract = load_json(B3_CONTRACT)

    if b3_summary.get("status") != "V16B_INDEPENDENT_FMM_POLLOCK_COMPARISON_COMPLETE":
        raise RuntimeError("V16B-4 requires completed V16B-3.")

    with np.load(FOUNDATION_NPZ, allow_pickle=False) as db:
        foundation = {k: np.array(db[k], copy=True) for k in db.files}

    with np.load(B1_SPEED, allow_pickle=False) as db:
        speed_db = {k: np.array(db[k], copy=True) for k in db.files}

    with np.load(B2_ARRIVAL, allow_pickle=False) as db:
        b2 = {k: np.array(db[k], copy=True) for k in db.files}

    with np.load(B3_COMPARISON, allow_pickle=False) as db:
        b3 = {k: np.array(db[k], copy=True) for k in db.files}

    save_csv(IDENTITY_CSV, [{
        "foundation_sha256": sha256_file(FOUNDATION_NPZ),
        "B1_speed_sha256": sha256_file(B1_SPEED),
        "B2_arrival_sha256": sha256_file(B2_ARRIVAL),
        "B3_comparison_sha256": sha256_file(B3_COMPARISON),
    }])

    xyz = np.asarray(b3["streamline_xyz_m"], dtype=np.float64)
    pollock = np.asarray(b3["pollock_tof_s"], dtype=np.float64)
    fmm_aligned = np.asarray(b3["fmm_sample_seed_aligned_s"], dtype=np.float64)

    dx = float(np.asarray(b2["dx_m"]).reshape(-1)[0])
    dy = float(np.asarray(b2["dy_m"]).reshape(-1)[0])
    dz = float(np.asarray(b2["dz_m"]).reshape(-1)[0])
    origin = np.asarray(b3["origin_center_m"], dtype=np.float64)

    Vxc = np.asarray(speed_db["Vxc_m_s"], dtype=np.float64)
    Vyc = np.asarray(speed_db["Vyc_m_s"], dtype=np.float64)
    Vzc = np.asarray(speed_db["Vzc_m_s"], dtype=np.float64)
    speed = np.asarray(speed_db["speed_raw_m_s"], dtype=np.float64)

    Kx = np.asarray(foundation["Kx"], dtype=np.float64)
    Ky = np.asarray(foundation["Ky"], dtype=np.float64)
    Kz = np.asarray(foundation["Kz"], dtype=np.float64)

    T = np.asarray(b2["arrival_time_s"], dtype=np.float64)

    # FMM gradient vector.
    dT_dz, dT_dy, dT_dx = np.gradient(T, dz, dy, dx, edge_order=1)

    # Sample frozen fields along Pollock trajectories.
    vx_s = trilinear(Vxc, xyz, dx, dy, dz, origin)
    vy_s = trilinear(Vyc, xyz, dx, dy, dz, origin)
    vz_s = trilinear(Vzc, xyz, dx, dy, dz, origin)
    speed_s = trilinear(speed, xyz, dx, dy, dz, origin)

    gx_s = trilinear(dT_dx, xyz, dx, dy, dz, origin)
    gy_s = trilinear(dT_dy, xyz, dx, dy, dz, origin)
    gz_s = trilinear(dT_dz, xyz, dx, dy, dz, origin)

    kx_s = trilinear(Kx, xyz, dx, dy, dz, origin)
    ky_s = trilinear(Ky, xyz, dx, dy, dz, origin)
    kz_s = trilinear(Kz, xyz, dx, dy, dz, origin)

    # Streamline tangent from frozen coordinates.
    seg = np.diff(xyz, axis=1)
    seg_len = np.linalg.norm(seg, axis=2)

    tangent_seg = normalize(seg)

    # Node tangent: average neighboring segment tangents.
    tangent = np.zeros_like(xyz)
    tangent[:, 0, :] = tangent_seg[:, 0, :]
    tangent[:, -1, :] = tangent_seg[:, -1, :]
    tangent[:, 1:-1, :] = normalize(
        tangent_seg[:, :-1, :] + tangent_seg[:, 1:, :]
    )

    velocity_vec = np.stack([vx_s, vy_s, vz_s], axis=-1)
    velocity_hat = normalize(velocity_vec)

    grad_vec = np.stack([gx_s, gy_s, gz_s], axis=-1)
    grad_hat = normalize(grad_vec)

    tangent_velocity_cos = np.sum(tangent * velocity_hat, axis=-1)

    # Arrival-time gradient points toward increasing T. Positive alignment means
    # streamline direction follows increasing FMM arrival time.
    tangent_grad_cos = np.sum(tangent * grad_hat, axis=-1)

    # Path geometry.
    path_length = np.sum(seg_len, axis=1)
    displacement_vec = xyz[:, -1, :] - xyz[:, 0, :]
    displacement = np.linalg.norm(displacement_vec, axis=1)
    tortuosity = path_length / np.maximum(displacement, 1e-30)

    vertical_path = np.sum(np.abs(seg[:, :, 2]), axis=1)
    vertical_fraction = vertical_path / np.maximum(path_length, 1e-30)

    # Heterogeneity summaries.
    kh_s = 0.5 * (kx_s + ky_s)
    logk = np.log(np.maximum(kh_s, 1e-30))

    mean_logk = np.mean(logk, axis=1)
    std_logk = np.std(logk, axis=1)
    mean_kzkh = np.mean(kz_s / np.maximum(kh_s, 1e-30), axis=1)

    mean_speed = np.mean(speed_s, axis=1)
    cv_speed = np.std(speed_s, axis=1) / np.maximum(mean_speed, 1e-30)

    mean_tangent_velocity_cos = np.mean(tangent_velocity_cos, axis=1)
    mean_tangent_grad_cos = np.mean(tangent_grad_cos, axis=1)

    # Monotonicity discrepancy.
    fmm_steps = np.diff(fmm_aligned, axis=1)
    negative_step_count = np.sum(fmm_steps < -1e-10, axis=1)
    negative_step_fraction = negative_step_count / fmm_steps.shape[1]
    most_negative_step_days = np.min(fmm_steps, axis=1) / SECONDS_PER_DAY

    # Terminal discrepancy.
    terminal_error_days = (
        fmm_aligned[:, -1] - pollock[:, -1]
    ) / SECONDS_PER_DAY

    terminal_ratio = (
        fmm_aligned[:, -1]
        / np.maximum(pollock[:, -1], 1e-30)
    )

    # Per-streamline table.
    rows = []
    for s in range(xyz.shape[0]):
        rows.append({
            "streamline": s,
            "path_length_m": float(path_length[s]),
            "displacement_m": float(displacement[s]),
            "tortuosity": float(tortuosity[s]),
            "vertical_fraction": float(vertical_fraction[s]),
            "mean_tangent_velocity_cos": float(mean_tangent_velocity_cos[s]),
            "mean_tangent_FMM_gradient_cos": float(mean_tangent_grad_cos[s]),
            "mean_log_horizontal_perm": float(mean_logk[s]),
            "std_log_horizontal_perm": float(std_logk[s]),
            "mean_Kz_Kh": float(mean_kzkh[s]),
            "mean_speed_m_s": float(mean_speed[s]),
            "speed_CV": float(cv_speed[s]),
            "FMM_negative_step_count": int(negative_step_count[s]),
            "FMM_negative_step_fraction": float(negative_step_fraction[s]),
            "most_negative_step_days": float(most_negative_step_days[s]),
            "Pollock_terminal_days": float(pollock[s, -1] / SECONDS_PER_DAY),
            "FMM_terminal_days": float(fmm_aligned[s, -1] / SECONDS_PER_DAY),
            "terminal_error_days": float(terminal_error_days[s]),
            "terminal_ratio": float(terminal_ratio[s]),
            "endpoint_x_m": float(xyz[s, -1, 0]),
            "endpoint_y_m": float(xyz[s, -1, 1]),
            "endpoint_z_m": float(xyz[s, -1, 2]),
        })
    save_csv(STREAMLINE_CSV, rows)

    features = {
        "path_length_m": path_length,
        "displacement_m": displacement,
        "tortuosity": tortuosity,
        "vertical_fraction": vertical_fraction,
        "mean_tangent_velocity_cos": mean_tangent_velocity_cos,
        "mean_tangent_FMM_gradient_cos": mean_tangent_grad_cos,
        "mean_log_horizontal_perm": mean_logk,
        "std_log_horizontal_perm": std_logk,
        "mean_speed_m_s": mean_speed,
        "speed_CV": cv_speed,
        "FMM_negative_step_fraction": negative_step_fraction,
    }

    corr_rows = []
    for name, x in features.items():
        corr_rows.append({
            "feature": name,
            "corr_with_signed_terminal_error": safe_corr(x, terminal_error_days),
            "corr_with_abs_terminal_error": safe_corr(x, np.abs(terminal_error_days)),
            "corr_with_terminal_ratio": safe_corr(x, terminal_ratio),
        })
    save_csv(CORR_CSV, corr_rows)

    # Identify strongest absolute explanatory correlations descriptively.
    valid_corrs = []
    for r in corr_rows:
        c = r["corr_with_abs_terminal_error"]
        if np.isfinite(c):
            valid_corrs.append((abs(c), r["feature"], c))
    valid_corrs.sort(reverse=True)

    strongest_feature = valid_corrs[0][1] if valid_corrs else "UNRESOLVED"
    strongest_corr = valid_corrs[0][2] if valid_corrs else float("nan")

    # Nonmonotonicity and directionality.
    node_negative = fmm_steps < -1e-10
    # compare tangent-gradient cosine at segment starts where FMM decreases
    tg_seg = tangent_grad_cos[:, :-1]
    tv_seg = tangent_velocity_cos[:, :-1]

    neg_tg = tg_seg[node_negative]
    pos_tg = tg_seg[~node_negative]
    neg_tv = tv_seg[node_negative]
    pos_tv = tv_seg[~node_negative]

    mono_rows = [{
        "negative_FMM_step_count": int(np.sum(node_negative)),
        "total_FMM_steps": int(node_negative.size),
        "negative_step_fraction": float(np.mean(node_negative)),
        "mean_tangent_grad_cos_negative_steps": float(np.mean(neg_tg)) if neg_tg.size else float("nan"),
        "mean_tangent_grad_cos_nonnegative_steps": float(np.mean(pos_tg)) if pos_tg.size else float("nan"),
        "mean_tangent_velocity_cos_negative_steps": float(np.mean(neg_tv)) if neg_tv.size else float("nan"),
        "mean_tangent_velocity_cos_nonnegative_steps": float(np.mean(pos_tv)) if pos_tv.size else float("nan"),
        "corr_negative_step_fraction_with_terminal_abs_error": safe_corr(
            negative_step_fraction, np.abs(terminal_error_days)
        ),
    }]
    save_csv(MONO_CSV, mono_rows)

    bin_rows = []
    for name in [
        "tortuosity",
        "vertical_fraction",
        "mean_tangent_velocity_cos",
        "mean_tangent_FMM_gradient_cos",
        "std_log_horizontal_perm",
        "speed_CV",
        "FMM_negative_step_fraction",
    ]:
        bin_rows.extend(binned_rows(name, features[name], terminal_error_days))
    save_csv(BIN_CSV, bin_rows)

    # Endpoint spatial bins only; no producer labels are inferred.
    xmid = 0.5 * (np.min(xyz[:, -1, 0]) + np.max(xyz[:, -1, 0]))
    ymid = 0.5 * (np.min(xyz[:, -1, 1]) + np.max(xyz[:, -1, 1]))

    endpoint_groups = {
        "LOW_X_LOW_Y": (xyz[:, -1, 0] <= xmid) & (xyz[:, -1, 1] <= ymid),
        "HIGH_X_LOW_Y": (xyz[:, -1, 0] > xmid) & (xyz[:, -1, 1] <= ymid),
        "LOW_X_HIGH_Y": (xyz[:, -1, 0] <= xmid) & (xyz[:, -1, 1] > ymid),
        "HIGH_X_HIGH_Y": (xyz[:, -1, 0] > xmid) & (xyz[:, -1, 1] > ymid),
    }

    endpoint_rows = []
    for name, m in endpoint_groups.items():
        if not np.any(m):
            continue
        endpoint_rows.append({
            "spatial_bin": name,
            "count": int(np.sum(m)),
            "mean_terminal_error_days": float(np.mean(terminal_error_days[m])),
            "median_terminal_error_days": float(np.median(terminal_error_days[m])),
            "mean_abs_terminal_error_days": float(np.mean(np.abs(terminal_error_days[m]))),
            "median_terminal_ratio": float(np.median(terminal_ratio[m])),
        })
    save_csv(ENDPOINT_CSV, endpoint_rows)

    # Interpretation.
    median_ratio = float(np.median(terminal_ratio))
    median_error = float(np.median(terminal_error_days))
    mean_tv = float(np.mean(mean_tangent_velocity_cos))
    mean_tg = float(np.mean(mean_tangent_grad_cos))
    neg_fraction = float(np.mean(node_negative))

    isotropic_shortcut = median_ratio < 0.8
    directional_nonmono = neg_fraction > 0.05
    velocity_following = mean_tv > 0.8
    fmm_gradient_mismatch = mean_tg < 0.8

    if isotropic_shortcut and directional_nonmono and velocity_following:
        interpretation = "ISOTROPIC_FMM_SHORTCUT_BIAS_WITH_DIRECTIONAL_ADVECTIVE_PATH_MISMATCH"
        directional_extension_warranted = True
    elif isotropic_shortcut:
        interpretation = "SYSTEMATIC_ISOTROPIC_FMM_TRAVEL_TIME_UNDERESTIMATION"
        directional_extension_warranted = True
    else:
        interpretation = "NO_STRONG_DIRECTIONAL_EXTENSION_REQUIREMENT_FROM_CURRENT_AUDIT"
        directional_extension_warranted = False

    save_csv(INTERPRET_CSV, [{
        "interpretation": interpretation,
        "directional_extension_warranted": directional_extension_warranted,
        "median_terminal_FMM_to_Pollock_ratio": median_ratio,
        "median_terminal_error_days": median_error,
        "mean_tangent_velocity_cos": mean_tv,
        "mean_tangent_FMM_gradient_cos": mean_tg,
        "FMM_negative_step_fraction": neg_fraction,
        "strongest_abs_error_feature": strongest_feature,
        "strongest_abs_error_correlation": strongest_corr,
        "meaning": (
            "Diagnostic interpretation only. No correction or new speed field is fitted here."
        ),
    }])

    np.savez_compressed(
        AUDIT_NPZ,
        path_length_m=path_length,
        displacement_m=displacement,
        tortuosity=tortuosity,
        vertical_fraction=vertical_fraction,
        mean_tangent_velocity_cos=mean_tangent_velocity_cos,
        mean_tangent_FMM_gradient_cos=mean_tangent_grad_cos,
        mean_log_horizontal_perm=mean_logk,
        std_log_horizontal_perm=std_logk,
        mean_speed_m_s=mean_speed,
        speed_CV=cv_speed,
        negative_step_fraction=negative_step_fraction,
        terminal_error_days=terminal_error_days,
        terminal_ratio=terminal_ratio,
        tangent_velocity_cos=tangent_velocity_cos,
        tangent_FMM_gradient_cos=tangent_grad_cos,
        authority_label_ascii=np.frombuffer(
            b"PAD_STREAM_V16B4_DIRECTIONALITY_AUDIT",
            dtype=np.uint8,
        ),
    )

    gates = [
        ("V16B3_status_reproduced", True),
        ("foundation_identity_recorded", True),
        ("B1_speed_identity_recorded", True),
        ("B2_arrival_identity_recorded", True),
        ("B3_comparison_identity_recorded", True),
        ("streamline_path_geometry_computed", True),
        ("tortuosity_computed", True),
        ("vertical_motion_fraction_computed", True),
        ("velocity_alignment_computed", True),
        ("FMM_gradient_alignment_computed", True),
        ("permeability_heterogeneity_sampled", True),
        ("speed_variability_sampled", True),
        ("nonmonotonicity_structure_audited", True),
        ("endpoint_spatial_structure_audited_without_producer_labels", True),
        ("discrepancy_feature_correlations_computed", True),
        ("no_directional_correction_fitted", True),
        ("no_producer_id_invented", True),
        ("no_FMM_speed_change", True),
        ("no_FMM_rerun", True),
        ("no_Pollock_retrace", True),
        ("no_SG3_SG4_rerun", True),
        ("foundation_not_modified", True),
        ("no_model_predict", True),
        ("no_training", True),
    ]
    save_csv(GATES_CSV, [{"gate": g, "passed": bool(p)} for g,p in gates])

    all_pass = all(bool(p) for _,p in gates)

    if all_pass:
        status = "V16B_FMM_POLLOCK_DIRECTIONAL_DISCREPANCY_AUDIT_COMPLETE"
        diagnosis = interpretation
        if directional_extension_warranted:
            recommendation = (
                "Preserve the isotropic FMM baseline as the control. Proceed to V16B-5 to design, but not yet solve, "
                "a directional/anisotropic arrival-time formulation that respects frozen velocity orientation. "
                "Do not tune the original isotropic speed field."
            )
            next_ms = "V16B-5 — Directional / Anisotropic Arrival-Time Formulation Design"
        else:
            recommendation = (
                "Preserve the isotropic FMM baseline. Proceed to V16B-5 as a baseline closure/visualization milestone "
                "rather than introducing directional physics."
            )
            next_ms = "V16B-5 — FMM Baseline Closure / Visualization"
    else:
        status = "V16B_DIRECTIONALITY_AUDIT_BLOCKED"
        diagnosis = "ONE_OR_MORE_DIRECTIONALITY_AUDIT_GATES_FAILED"
        recommendation = "Audit only failed V16B-4 structural diagnostics."
        next_ms = "V16B-4R — Directionality Audit Residual Repair"

    save_csv(DECISION_CSV, [{
        "status": status,
        "diagnosis": diagnosis,
        "directional_extension_warranted": directional_extension_warranted,
        "median_terminal_ratio": median_ratio,
        "median_terminal_error_days": median_error,
        "FMM_negative_step_fraction": neg_fraction,
        "strongest_abs_error_feature": strongest_feature,
        "strongest_abs_error_correlation": strongest_corr,
        "audit_npz_sha256": sha256_file(AUDIT_NPZ),
        "next_milestone": next_ms,
    }])

    contract = {
        "milestone": "V16B-4",
        "status": status,
        "diagnosis": diagnosis,
        "directional_extension_warranted": directional_extension_warranted,
        "metrics": {
            "median_terminal_FMM_to_Pollock_ratio": median_ratio,
            "median_terminal_error_days": median_error,
            "mean_tangent_velocity_cos": mean_tv,
            "mean_tangent_FMM_gradient_cos": mean_tg,
            "FMM_negative_step_fraction": neg_fraction,
            "strongest_abs_error_feature": strongest_feature,
            "strongest_abs_error_correlation": strongest_corr,
        },
        "interpretation_policy": {
            "diagnostic_only": True,
            "isotropic_speed_recalibrated": False,
            "directional_correction_fitted": False,
            "producer_labels_inferred": False,
        },
        "output": {
            "file": str(AUDIT_NPZ),
            "sha256": sha256_file(AUDIT_NPZ),
        },
        "recommendation": recommendation,
        "next_milestone": next_ms,
    }
    save_json(CONTRACT_JSON, contract)

    save_json(SUMMARY_JSON, {
        "milestone": "V16B-4",
        "status": status,
        "diagnosis": diagnosis,
        "directional_extension_warranted": directional_extension_warranted,
        "median_terminal_FMM_to_Pollock_ratio": median_ratio,
        "median_terminal_error_days": median_error,
        "FMM_negative_step_fraction": neg_fraction,
        "strongest_abs_error_feature": strongest_feature,
        "strongest_abs_error_correlation": strongest_corr,
        "recommendation": recommendation,
        "next_milestone": next_ms,
    })

    print("DISCREPANCY STRUCTURE")
    print(f"  Median terminal FMM/Pollock : {median_ratio:.6f}")
    print(f"  Median terminal error       : {median_error:.6f} days")
    print(f"  FMM negative-step fraction  : {neg_fraction:.6f}")
    print(f"  Mean tangent·velocity       : {mean_tv:.6f}")
    print(f"  Mean tangent·grad(T_FMM)    : {mean_tg:.6f}")

    print("\nSTRONGEST ABS-ERROR ASSOCIATION")
    print(f"  Feature                     : {strongest_feature}")
    print(f"  Correlation                 : {strongest_corr:.6f}")

    print("\nINTERPRETATION")
    print(f"  {interpretation}")
    print(f"  Directional extension       : {directional_extension_warranted}")

    print("\n" + "=" * 78)
    print("V16B-4 FINAL DIRECTIONALITY GATES")
    print("=" * 78)
    for g,p in gates:
        print(f"[{'PASS' if p else 'FAIL'}] {g}")
    print("=" * 78)

    print("\nSTATUS")
    print(f"  {status}")
    print("\nDIAGNOSIS")
    print(f"  {diagnosis}")
    print("\nRECOMMENDATION")
    print(f"  {recommendation}")
    print("\nNEXT MILESTONE")
    print(f"  {next_ms}")

    print("\nOUTPUTS")
    print(f"  Directory:\n    {OUT}")
    print("\nNumerical:")
    print(f"  {AUDIT_NPZ.name}")
    print(f"  SHA-256: {sha256_file(AUDIT_NPZ)}")
    print("\nTables:")
    for p in [
        IDENTITY_CSV, STREAMLINE_CSV, CORR_CSV, MONO_CSV,
        BIN_CSV, ENDPOINT_CSV, INTERPRET_CSV, GATES_CSV, DECISION_CSV
    ]:
        print(f"  {p.name}")
    print("\nContract:")
    print(f"  {CONTRACT_JSON.name}")
    print("\nSummary:")
    print(f"  {SUMMARY_JSON.name}")

    print("\n" + "=" * 78)
    print("PAD-STREAM V16B-4 FMM / POLLOCK DIRECTIONALITY AUDIT: COMPLETE")
    print("=" * 78)

def main():
    print("\n" + "=" * 78)
    print("PAD-Stream V16C-2")
    print("Multi-Coordinate Streamline Transport Database Assembly")
    print("=" * 78)

    print("""
V16C-1 INTEGRATION CONTRACT IS IMMUTABLE.
FOUNDATION CASE 0001 IS IMMUTABLE.
V16B-2 FMM IS IMMUTABLE.
V16B-7 ADV IS IMMUTABLE.
FROZEN POLLOCK XYZ / TOF / WEIGHTS ARE IMMUTABLE.

NO TRANSPORT SOLVE WILL BE EXECUTED.
NO SATURATION FIELD WILL BE GENERATED.
NO PI-RNN WILL BE TRAINED OR INFERRED.
NO GRID MAP-BACK WILL BE EXECUTED.
NO FMM OR ADV SOLVE WILL BE RERUN.
NO POLLOCK STREAMLINE WILL BE RETRACED.
NO CHANNEL NORMALIZATION OR FITTING WILL BE PERFORMED.
NO PRODUCER ID WILL BE INVENTED.

THIS MILESTONE ASSEMBLES RAW SOURCE-AUTHENTIC CONDITIONING CHANNELS ONLY.
""")

    for p in [
        FOUNDATION_NPZ,
        B2_NPZ,
        B3_NPZ,
        B7_NPZ,
        B8_NPZ,
        C1_SUMMARY,
        C1_CONTRACT,
    ]:
        if not p.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(p)

    c1 = load_json(C1_SUMMARY)

    if c1.get("status") != "V16C_TRAVEL_TIME_HIERARCHY_INTEGRATION_CONTRACT_READY":
        raise RuntimeError("V16C-2 requires completed V16C-1.")

    with np.load(FOUNDATION_NPZ, allow_pickle=False) as db:
        required = [
            "Kx", "Ky", "Kz", "porosity", "pressure",
            "streamline_xyz", "pollock_tof", "streamline_weight",
        ]
        missing = [k for k in required if k not in db.files]
        if missing:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Foundation missing required channels: {missing}")

        Kx = np.asarray(db["Kx"], dtype=np.float64)
        Ky = np.asarray(db["Ky"], dtype=np.float64)
        Kz = np.asarray(db["Kz"], dtype=np.float64)
        porosity = np.asarray(db["porosity"], dtype=np.float64)
        pressure = np.asarray(db["pressure"], dtype=np.float64)
        weight = np.asarray(db["streamline_weight"], dtype=np.float64)

    with np.load(B2_NPZ, allow_pickle=False) as db:
        T_fmm = np.asarray(db["arrival_time_s"], dtype=np.float64)
        dx = float(np.asarray(db["dx_m"]).reshape(-1)[0])
        dy = float(np.asarray(db["dy_m"]).reshape(-1)[0])
        dz = float(np.asarray(db["dz_m"]).reshape(-1)[0])

    with np.load(B3_NPZ, allow_pickle=False) as db:
        xyz_m = np.asarray(db["streamline_xyz_m"], dtype=np.float64)
        pollock_tof_s = np.asarray(db["pollock_tof_s"], dtype=np.float64)
        origin = np.asarray(db["origin_center_m"], dtype=np.float64)
        fmm_b3 = np.asarray(db["fmm_sample_raw_s"], dtype=np.float64)

    with np.load(B7_NPZ, allow_pickle=False) as db:
        tau_adv = np.asarray(db["tau_adv_s"], dtype=np.float64)

    with np.load(B8_NPZ, allow_pickle=False) as db:
        fmm_b8 = np.asarray(db["fmm_sample_s"], dtype=np.float64)
        adv_b8 = np.asarray(db["adv_sample_s"], dtype=np.float64)
        pollock_b8 = np.asarray(db["pollock_tof_s"], dtype=np.float64)

    if xyz_m.shape != (1078, 201, 3):
        raise RuntimeError(f"Unexpected Pollock XYZ shape: {xyz_m.shape}")

    if pollock_tof_s.shape != (1078, 201):
        raise RuntimeError(f"Unexpected Pollock TOF shape: {pollock_tof_s.shape}")

    if weight.ndim != 1 or weight.shape[0] != xyz_m.shape[0]:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"Unexpected streamline_weight shape {weight.shape}; expected ({xyz_m.shape[0]},)"
        )

    grid_shape = (15, 50, 50)
    for name, arr in [
        ("Kx", Kx),
        ("Ky", Ky),
        ("Kz", Kz),
        ("porosity", porosity),
        ("pressure", pressure),
        ("T_fmm", T_fmm),
        ("tau_adv", tau_adv),
    ]:
        if arr.shape != grid_shape:
            raise RuntimeError(f"{name} shape {arr.shape} != {grid_shape}")

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Sample all frozen grid channels onto the same frozen Pollock nodes.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    fmm_s, audit_fmm = trilinear(T_fmm, xyz_m, dx, dy, dz, origin)
    adv_s, audit_adv = trilinear(tau_adv, xyz_m, dx, dy, dz, origin)

    kx_s, audit_kx = trilinear(Kx, xyz_m, dx, dy, dz, origin)
    ky_s, audit_ky = trilinear(Ky, xyz_m, dx, dy, dz, origin)
    kz_s, audit_kz = trilinear(Kz, xyz_m, dx, dy, dz, origin)
    phi_s, audit_phi = trilinear(porosity, xyz_m, dx, dy, dz, origin)
    p_s, audit_p = trilinear(pressure, xyz_m, dx, dy, dz, origin)

    # Existing B3/B8 travel-time mapping must be exactly reproduced to numerical
    # roundoff under the frozen mapping contract.
    fmm_linf_b3 = float(np.max(np.abs(fmm_s - fmm_b3)))
    fmm_linf_b8 = float(np.max(np.abs(fmm_s - fmm_b8)))
    adv_linf_b8 = float(np.max(np.abs(adv_s - adv_b8)))
    pollock_linf_b8 = float(np.max(np.abs(pollock_tof_s - pollock_b8)))

    save_csv(
        IDENTITY_CSV,
        [{
            "foundation_sha256": sha256_file(FOUNDATION_NPZ),
            "V16B2_FMM_sha256": sha256_file(B2_NPZ),
            "V16B3_mapping_sha256": sha256_file(B3_NPZ),
            "V16B7_ADV_sha256": sha256_file(B7_NPZ),
            "V16B8_comparison_sha256": sha256_file(B8_NPZ),
            "V16C1_contract_sha256": sha256_file(C1_CONTRACT),
            "grid_shape": str(grid_shape),
            "streamline_count": xyz_m.shape[0],
            "node_count": xyz_m.shape[1],
        }],
    )

    channel_rows = [
        {
            "channel": "xyz_m",
            "domain": "streamline_node",
            "shape": str(tuple(xyz_m.shape)),
            "authority": "FROZEN_POLLOCK",
            "role": "geometry",
            "units": "m",
        },
        {
            "channel": "pollock_tof_s",
            "domain": "streamline_node",
            "shape": str(tuple(pollock_tof_s.shape)),
            "authority": "AUTHORITATIVE_TRANSPORT_COORDINATE",
            "role": "primary_transport_coordinate",
            "units": "s",
        },
        {
            "channel": "fmm_arrival_s",
            "domain": "streamline_node",
            "shape": str(tuple(fmm_s.shape)),
            "authority": "SAMPLED_FROM_FROZEN_V16B2",
            "role": "scalar_connectivity_context",
            "units": "s",
        },
        {
            "channel": "adv_travel_time_s",
            "domain": "streamline_node",
            "shape": str(tuple(adv_s.shape)),
            "authority": "SAMPLED_FROM_FROZEN_V16B7",
            "role": "directional_eulerian_context",
            "units": "s",
        },
        {
            "channel": "Kx",
            "domain": "streamline_node",
            "shape": str(tuple(kx_s.shape)),
            "authority": "SAMPLED_FROM_FOUNDATION",
            "role": "geology_context",
            "units": "mD",
        },
        {
            "channel": "Ky",
            "domain": "streamline_node",
            "shape": str(tuple(ky_s.shape)),
            "authority": "SAMPLED_FROM_FOUNDATION",
            "role": "geology_context",
            "units": "mD",
        },
        {
            "channel": "Kz",
            "domain": "streamline_node",
            "shape": str(tuple(kz_s.shape)),
            "authority": "SAMPLED_FROM_FOUNDATION",
            "role": "geology_context",
            "units": "mD",
        },
        {
            "channel": "porosity",
            "domain": "streamline_node",
            "shape": str(tuple(phi_s.shape)),
            "authority": "SAMPLED_FROM_FOUNDATION",
            "role": "storage_context",
            "units": "fraction",
        },
        {
            "channel": "pressure",
            "domain": "streamline_node",
            "shape": str(tuple(p_s.shape)),
            "authority": "SAMPLED_FROM_FOUNDATION",
            "role": "pressure_context",
            "units": "psi",
        },
        {
            "channel": "streamline_weight",
            "domain": "streamline",
            "shape": str(tuple(weight.shape)),
            "authority": "FROZEN_POLLOCK",
            "role": "flux_weight",
            "units": "m3/s",
        },
    ]
    save_csv(CHANNEL_CSV, channel_rows)

    sampling_rows = []
    for name, audit in [
        ("FMM", audit_fmm),
        ("ADV", audit_adv),
        ("Kx", audit_kx),
        ("Ky", audit_ky),
        ("Kz", audit_kz),
        ("porosity", audit_phi),
        ("pressure", audit_p),
    ]:
        sampling_rows.append({
            "channel": name,
            "method": "TRILINEAR_CELL_CENTERED",
            "origin_x_m": float(origin[0]),
            "origin_y_m": float(origin[1]),
            "origin_z_m": float(origin[2]),
            "dx_m": dx,
            "dy_m": dy,
            "dz_m": dz,
            **audit,
        })
    save_csv(SAMPLING_CSV, sampling_rows)

    stats_rows = [
